title: Sanofi
summary: French pharmaceutical group with vaccines, immunology and rare-disease franchises.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Sanofi sells vaccines, immunology medicines, rare-disease therapies and consumer health products, and has been spinning off consumer health to focus on innovative biopharma. Its Dupixent franchise is a major growth driver, and it is expanding in vaccines and neurology. Pipeline setbacks have weighed on sentiment.

Technology Exposure

  • Immunology and inflammation
  • Vaccines
  • Rare disease and neurology

What To Watch

  • Dupixent growth and competition
  • Vaccine demand
  • Pipeline execution

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
